title: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all…
description: The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 7.8.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'data' parameter. Authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. The vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, specifically due to ineffective use of the wp_kses_post filter and missing esc_attr() escaping on the element_id attribute in template-tab.php.
